title: Grid Auto Flow
definition: Utilities for controlling how the auto-placement algorithm works, specifying exactly how items flow into the grid.
simpleExplanation: When you dump 10 items into a grid, do they fill up the columns first (left-to-right), or do they fill up the rows first (top-to-bottom)? Auto-flow lets you decide.
realWorldExample: Using `grid-flow-col` to create a horizontal scrolling carousel where items naturally stack sideways into columns instead of wrapping downward.

basic: What is the default auto-flow direction for CSS Grid?

answers.question: Default direction?
answers.answer: Row (left-to-right, then wraps down to the next row).

answers.question: dense?
answers.answer: If you have items of different sizes (`col-span-2`), sometimes they leave ugly empty holes in the grid. `dense` tells the browser's algorithm to go back and pack smaller items into those empty holes, completely rearranging your HTML order to make the grid fit perfectly like Tetris.
